text:
alex: Heads up — after the RBAC role inheritance change rolled at 09:12, we're seeing Viewer-role principals able to call kms:DescribeKey and list key aliases across tenant boundaries. :rotating_light:

maria: whoa. any customer impact observed?

alex: No confirmed decrypts, but audit shows DescribeKey + ListAliases on keys in other accounts. snippet from audit:
```
{"time":"2026-02-03T09:15:34Z","principal":"svc-viewer@redwood","action":"kms:DescribeKey","resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01"}
```

danielle: That matches the change we shipped — role-mapper allowed parent-role perms to propagate to service accounts when we enabled "inherit_roles: true". Looks like we missed the tenant-scoped filter.

prateek: Pushing emergency mitigation now: reverting inherit_roles default to false and patching role-mapper config to force tenant_id check. rolling restart staged for role-mapper v2 (3 pods). ETA ~6m.

sec-bot: Incident created: SEC-2026-042 | Privilege inheritance exposing KMS metadata across tenants. Priority: P1 (potential data exposure). Pager: @oncall.

oncall: I'm on it. notify infra and SRE. any blocking migrations?

maria: quick checklist — 1) revoke any short-lived tokens issued since 09:12 (we have token_issues log) 2) add an audit filter to escalate any kms:* requests from viewer roles 3) notify CS to flag affected tenants if needed

alex: Commands I'm running: 
```
# revert config
kubectl set env deploy/role-mapper INHERIT_ROLES=false -n platform
# restart pods
kubectl rollout restart deploy/role-mapper -n platform
```

prateek: Also applying a temporary IAM guard on the control plane: deny kms:DescribeKey/ListAliases for principals with role=viewer across tenant boundaries. Will remove in controlled change after fix.

danielle: I pulled the audit index — affected principals: svc-viewer-1, svc-viewer-3, user:mike@redwood (dev test account). No production customer keys were decrypted. Confirmed by key-usage logs (zero Decrypt).

maria: Good — still treat as data-exposure risk. Creating notification draft for stakeholders and compliance.

alex: After restart, role-mapper pods are back. Can people run a quick smoke to confirm ListAliases now returns 403 for cross-tenant callers?

prateek: smoke results: all cross-tenant attempts blocked. sample: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer svc-viewer-1\" https://control-plane.internal/kms/keys/abcd` -> 403.

oncall: Logging elevated. Keeping incident open for 24h monitoring, running regression tests for other inherited-perm cases (secretsmanager, s3).

maria: postmortem owners? danielle + prateek. add timeline, root-cause (missing tenant filter in inheritance logic), impact, and mitigation steps.

alex: I'll upload incident logs and the exact role-mapper diff to the ticket. thumbs up if we can close the immediate emergency. :thumbsup:

maria: :thumbsup: good catch team. we'll follow up with an org-wide advisory on safe defaults for inheritance flags.

sec-bot: Added runbook checklist link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/iam-inheritance (edited)

alex: filing SEC-2026-042 update with mitigation notes and timeline.

(reacted :eyes: by maria)
